title: Quenched Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
description: A smoky, fluffy, crowd-pleaser Mediterranean quinoa bowl infused with allspice, fermented kimchi, and Ayurvedic sattvic-friendly flavors.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water until clear.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil, add quinoa, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until fluffy.
While quinoa cooks, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced eggplant until golden and soft, about 8 minutes.
Add 1 tsp allspice to the eggplant, stir for 30 seconds to release flavors.
Add chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Once quinoa is ready, fluff with a fork and transfer to a bowl.
Top the quinoa with sautéed eggplant-spinach mixture, crumbled feta, a dollop of hummus, chopped kimchi, and sliced olives.
Drizzle 1 tbsp lemon juice and the remaining olive oil over the bowl.
Season with a pinch of salt if desired and serve warm.
